name: campus-tanitim-video
description: 1401 Campus tanıtım videosu (Remotion). Ekranlar capture/ ile emülatörden çekilir.

scripts.capture: node capture/reset-emu.mjs && node capture/capture.mjs && node capture/yonetim.mjs
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Tanitim out/1401-campus-tanitim.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && remotion render src/index.ts Yonetim out/1401-campus-yonetim.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:rehber: node capture/ses.mjs && remotion render RehberBarista out/1401-campus-barista-rehberi.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 && remotion render RehberMudur out/1401-campus-magaza-muduru-rehberi.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
scripts.render:kurul: node capture/ses.mjs && remotion render Kurul out/1401-campus-yonetim-kurulu.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
